method: Inspect dense half-second contact sheets, full-size checkpoints at 2, 6, 10, 14, 18, and 19.9 seconds, and full-size frames on both sides of each Sora cut. Every image was decoded from the final encoded MP4.

blender.verdict: Deterministic continuity master and reusable previs. It proves topology and causal order, but its Eevee materials visibly read as CG and are below the production image-quality bar.

sora.verdict: Production master. The five-camera editorial cut is visually cohesive and materially stronger. The tight gate insert avoids packet deformation; the intact packet beyond the gate completes causality through film grammar. Independent Sora cells cannot provide Blender-level topology proof, so the Blender master remains the authoritative continuity reference.

recommendation.reason: Sora wins the audience-facing quality comparison; Blender wins deterministic repeatability and exact element control. Keeping both is the maintainable hybrid production system.
